summary: Learn real estate development feasibility and market analysis through DCF modeling, market analysis, and practical underwriting exercises. Enrol now.
lede: Real estate development feasibility and market analysis provides a structured way to evaluate land, demand, pricing, access, costs, planning hurdles, and delivery constraints before a project moves forward. This course helps you test absorption, review comparable evidence, build development cash flows, and assess whether the proposed project can support a defensible return. You will turn site notes, market reports, and broker commentary into a practical underwriting workflow using trade area mapping, DCF feasibility modeling, sensitivity analysis, and feasibility memo drafting. You will also build a site feasibility matrix and investment memorandum while gaining an overview of ESG screening, Power BI dashboard reporting, automated scenario testing, and broader valuation, legal, and delivery considerations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for real estate professionals who need to evaluate development opportunities with commercial discipline and practical market evidence. It is most relevant to you if you already work with project data, financial assumptions, or site review decisions and need a stronger feasibility method.
prerequisites: To get the most from this course, bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed and be ready to work through feasibility calculations and market evidence exercises. A sample site brief, recent market report, or project concept from your own work will help you apply the exercises more directly, although supplied datasets and templates are sufficient if you do not have one.
